commands_used: answer 1. I am Tarin, a thief and now Voh-Vastei (apprentice) of the Toh-Reel-Ka. The order wants the Eye of Argonia, the priest-kings Hist amber jewel, found before Cuts-the-Old-Knot, to heal the trees. Someone in Gideon market is selling an Eye, though most are glass. 2. Find the dealer selling the Eye in Gideon market, and learn where it came from. The marker points at Ovinius Calo here in Gideon. 3. Persuade him, pay him a few coins (I have about 350 gold), or pickpocket his papers. 4. I do not know who Cuts-the-Old-Knot is, what seal paste is, or Xeech-Leel and Umbriel. I can ask Nesh-Deeka or the dealer.

answer 1. The Eye on the stall is glass. Smugglers sold it to Ovinius and kept the old silver setting it came in, at Gideon South Watch. 2. Go to Gideon South Watch, SE of the quay, and take the setting from the locked chest in the inner room. 3. Fight the smugglers, sneak past them, pick the chest lock, or take the key from the boss (pickpocket). I favour paying or stealth as a thief. 4. I do not know who the Collector is beyond an Imperial relic-hunter also seeking the Eye; I can find out by meeting him or asking around.
use Door to South Watch Inner Room

answer 1. I stole the boss key and took the old silver setting. Ennodius Vanin, the Collector, a relic-hunter, had opened the chest first and left a note saying a ship name is scratched inside the band. 2. Bring the setting to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom, via the rootworm from the Hist garden in Gideon. 3. Go straight there, or first read the Collector note and look at the band. 4. I do not know the ship name yet or what the Collector wants; Nesh-Deeka may help.

answer 1. The setting was named the Pale Harvest, a Company freighter sunk in Hatandros Bight with a dealer stock aboard. Nesh-Deeka paid me 100 gold. The Unbound also asked about the glass Eye a month ago. 2. Nothing is set; the wreck at Hatandros Bight, east coast south of Thorn, is the next lead. 3. Ask Nesh-Deeka more, or head to the bight. 4. I do not know how Nesh-Deeka knows about the Unbound (she said we listen), nor who they are fully.

answer I am Tarin, thief and Voh-Vastei of the Toh-Reel-Ka. I paid Ovinius Calo in Gideon, pickpocketed the smuggler boss key at Gideon South Watch, took the old silver setting and the Collectors note (Ennodius Vanin, an Imperial relic-hunter after the Eye for twenty years). Nesh-Deeka read the ship name inside: the Pale Harvest, a Company freighter sunk in Hatandros Bight, east coast south of Thorn, with a Gideon dealer stock aboard. She paid 100 gold, so I have about 430 gold, plus the setting, the note, lockpick, armour and Hist blessing. The Unbound asked after the glass Eye in Gideon a month ago; she says we listen. Next lead: the wreck at Hatandros Bight. Still unknown: Cuts-the-Old-Knot, seal paste, Xeech-Leel, Umbriel.
